items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: Fritz played with him, Edmund Hall was playing with the band.

ctx.x: We missed, by the way we never did interview him yet, we ought to interview him pretty soon. Somehow we missed him, somehow we never did get to him.

Yeah, I think he has a picture of it. He told me, he has a picture of the band, you know, of the old things. Yeah, but he has a picture of it. Now, Count Hall, he may have been on that picture, I don't know. I don't think he was playing the band in the study acting. Well, I thought Edmund Hall was on that picture.
